title: Find structure
description: PCA, UMAP, HDBSCAN and K-means over the columns you choose: projections add PC_n / UMAP_n columns, labellings add Cluster Label.

sections.label: Method:
sections.description: Which question to ask of the chosen columns.

buttons.label: Columns
buttons.description: Choose which parameters the method sees. Strongly recommended: without a choice it falls back to the current x/y/z axes.

sections.label: Components:
sections.description: Components to keep. Two is usually enough to plot; more is useful when the first two explain little of the variance.

sections.label: Standardise columns
sections.description: Scale each column to unit variance first. Leave this on unless the columns genuinely share a scale.

sections.label: Neighbours:
sections.description: Size of the local neighbourhood. Larger = more global structure, smaller = more local detail.

sections.label: Min. distance:
sections.description: Minimum spacing of embedded points. Smaller = tighter clumps.

sections.label: Components:
sections.description: 2 to plot directly, 3 for more room.

sections.label: Advanced
sections.description: Settings that steer convergence rather than the result's meaning.

sections.label: Parallel jobs:
sections.description: Threads UMAP may use; -1 uses all cores.

sections.label: Epochs:
sections.description: Optimisation epochs; Auto lets UMAP choose from the data size.

sections.label: Min. samples:
sections.description: How conservative the density estimate is. Larger leaves more points unlabelled as noise.

sections.label: Min. cluster size:
sections.description: Smallest group that counts as a cluster rather than noise.

sections.label: Clusters:
sections.description: Every point is assigned to one of exactly this many groups, whether or not that many populations exist.

buttons.label: ▶ Run
buttons.description: Run the method on the chosen columns.

buttons.label: Plot
buttons.description: Show the projection in its own window.

buttons.label: Save
buttons.description: Write the cluster assignment to a folder.
